description: A practical Faisal Town Islamabad buyer guide covering Phase 1/F-18, Phase 2/FT-II, plots, houses, maps, payment checks and project verification.
intro:
Faisal Town Islamabad searches can refer to different projects, property types and locations. The first step is identifying whether you mean the established Faisal Town-I / Phase 1 market or the newer Faisal Town-II / Phase 2 project.

This guide explains the main differences, what buyers should compare, how to use maps and listings, and what to verify before paying for a plot, house or booking.
body:
## Faisal Town Islamabad at a glance

Faisal Town is part of the wider FaisalTown Group real-estate portfolio.

The group's current official project list separates its main residential communities into projects including:

- Faisal Town-I
- Faisal Town-II
- Faisal Hills
- Faisal Margalla City

Faisal Heights and Faisal Jewel are listed separately as high-rise projects rather than residential communities.

For a buyer searching “Faisal Town Islamabad,” the most important distinction on this website is between Faisal Town Phase 1 / Faisal Town-I and Faisal Town Phase 2 / Faisal Town-II.

They should not be treated as one continuous project.

## Faisal Town Phase 1 / Faisal Town-I

Faisal Town-I is the established project commonly associated with F-18 and the Rawalpindi-Kohat Road / N-80 side of the Islamabad-Rawalpindi region.

Current official FaisalTown Group material describes Phase 1 as an established community where house construction is progressing and families are already residing.

The main Phase 1 areas covered on this website are:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block B-1
- Block C

Blocks A, B and C have established resale activity, houses and plot inventory.

Block B-1 is newer and should be checked separately for its current development, availability and documentation.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 / Faisal Town-II

Faisal Town-II is a separate and much larger under-development project.

FaisalTown Group currently describes Faisal Town-II as a 40 million square metre residential community and identifies it as an under-development project.

Its planning is sector-based rather than using the Phase 1 A/B/C block structure.

Current detailed area guides on this website cover:

- Sector O / Model Block
- Sector P / The Caladan
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave

Phase 2 buyers should use the relevant sector or enclave plan rather than a Phase 1 block map.

## Phase 1 vs Phase 2

The two projects serve different buyer needs.

### Faisal Town Phase 1

Phase 1 generally offers:

- established streets
- active resale inventory
- built houses
- rental activity
- possession-oriented property
- visible surrounding development

### Faisal Town Phase 2

Phase 2 generally involves:

- newer sector-based inventory
- developing areas
- booking or payment-plan options
- resale and paid-file inventory
- longer development horizons
- project-wide master-plan comparisons

A lower Phase 2 entry price should not be compared directly with an established Phase 1 possession plot without accounting for development, payment status and timing.

## Which Faisal Town project should you choose?

Start with your purpose.

If you want an established plot, ready house or rental property, begin with Faisal Town Phase 1.

If you are considering a newer booking, developing sector or longer-term land investment, review Faisal Town Phase 2.

Then narrow the decision using:

- budget
- plot size
- intended use
- possession requirement
- payment preference
- location
- development
- resale plans

The project name alone should not decide the purchase.

## Faisal Town Phase 1 blocks

### Block A

Block A is an established Phase 1 residential block with active resale inventory.

Buyers commonly compare it by:

- plot size
- exact street
- road width
- possession
- corner or main-road location
- surroundings
- asking price

Use the dedicated Block A guide for detailed current comparisons.

### Block B

Block B is another established Phase 1 block and currently has strong resale activity.

Official FaisalTown Group material describes Block B as lying along Motorway M-1 and states that possession has been delivered.

Buyers should still verify possession, dues and transfer status for the exact property rather than relying only on block-level claims.

### Block B-1

Block B-1 is a newer Phase 1 addition.

Because its development and transaction position can differ from Blocks A, B and C, it should not automatically be compared like-for-like with established resale inventory.

Verify the current plot, development and regulatory position before payment.

### Block C

Block C is an established Phase 1 area with active plot, house and rental inventory.

It is particularly relevant to buyers looking at smaller plot and house categories as well as established residential surroundings.

Use the dedicated Block C page for exact prices, map position and inventory.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 sectors

### Sector O / Model Block

Sector O is commonly associated with Model Block terminology.

Use the exact plot reference and sector plan instead of assuming that every O-sector offer has the same payment or development status.

### Sector P / The Caladan

Sector P is currently one of the most clearly marketed Phase 2 opportunities on this website.

It has a dedicated plan and a separately presented current commercial offer.

Sector P pricing should not be generalized across the rest of Phase 2.

### Sector R

Sector R should be compared using the Phase 2 master plan and exact current inventory.

Its price and development position should be checked separately from Sector O or P.

### Sector S

Sector S has a dedicated plan and commonly marketed residential size categories.

Current payment and availability should be verified live before booking.

### Sector T

Sector T also has a dedicated plan.

Because public information can vary regarding some plot-size categories and current terms, use written current inventory rather than an older advertisement.

### Overseas Enclave

The Overseas Enclave is another Phase 2 area with dedicated planning and overseas-buyer relevance.

Remote buyers should pay particular attention to map matching, documentation, payment recipient details and live site verification.

## Faisal Town plots for sale

There is active plot inventory in both Phase 1 and Phase 2.

However, the term “plot for sale in Faisal Town Islamabad” can describe very different property types.

Phase 1 may involve:

- possession plots
- numbered resale plots
- fully paid plots
- special-location plots

Phase 2 may additionally involve:

- fresh booking
- installment inventory
- partially paid files
- fully paid files
- resale inventory
- sector-specific offers

Always establish exactly what is being sold before comparing prices.

## Plot sizes

Across Faisal Town-I and Faisal Town-II, buyers commonly encounter residential categories around:

- 5 or 5.56 marla
- 8 marla
- 10 or 10.89 marla
- 14 or 14.22 marla
- 1 kanal

Larger categories may exist in selected areas.

Do not assume every size is available in every block or sector.

Verify the exact documented dimensions.

## Houses for sale

Faisal Town Phase 1 has an established built-home resale market.

House buyers should compare more than land size.

Check:

- construction age
- structural condition
- seepage
- electrical work
- plumbing
- roof condition
- layout
- parking
- utility connections
- repair requirements
- current occupancy

A house that looks cheaper can become more expensive after renovation.

## Houses for rent

Phase 1 also has an active rental market.

Current rental searches include:

- full houses
- upper portions
- lower portions
- furnished homes

Tenants should compare:

- rent
- security deposit
- advance rent
- block
- utilities
- parking
- furnishing
- house condition
- notice period
- landlord authority

Rental inventory changes quickly, so live availability matters more than old listings.

## Faisal Town maps

Using the correct map is essential.

Use a Phase 1 map for:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block B-1
- Block C

Use the Phase 2 master plan or sector-specific map for:

- Sector O
- Sector P
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave

FaisalTown Group currently maintains separate downloadable project resources for Faisal Town Phase I and Faisal Town Phase II, which reinforces that the projects should be verified using their own plans.

## Google Maps vs project plans

Google Maps is useful for:

- driving routes
- current navigation
- approximate travel
- location pins

Project plans are useful for:

- block or sector identification
- plot layouts
- road widths
- internal land use
- project context

Use both.

Neither should replace plot-number verification or a physical site check.

## Location and access

Location should be evaluated differently for Phase 1 and Phase 2.

For Phase 1, the practical question is usually the exact block, street and access route within an established environment.

For Phase 2, buyers commonly compare broader motorway, Chakri Road, airport and Ring Road corridor access alongside the sector's position in the master plan.

Do not rely on one advertised travel-time figure.

Drive the actual route where possible.

## Current development

Development status should always be verified for the exact property.

FaisalTown Group currently describes Faisal Town-II as under development, while its Phase 1 material describes significant existing possession, construction and residential occupancy.

That broad distinction is useful, but it does not replace property-level inspection.

During a site visit check:

- roads
- drainage
- utilities
- plot demarcation
- surrounding houses
- active development work
- actual accessibility

## Payment plans

Payment terms can differ significantly by phase, sector and inventory.

Phase 1 resale property is usually negotiated around the seller's demand and any outstanding dues.

Phase 2 may involve:

- booking amounts
- down payments
- installments
- full-payment discounts
- development charges
- possession charges
- location premiums

FaisalTown Group currently provides separate project payment resources and official payment methods for Faisal Town-II, including its member portal, challan and listed company bank accounts.

Always obtain current written payment instructions for the exact property being purchased.

## Never pay using unverified instructions

Before transferring money, confirm:

- official recipient
- account title
- booking or transfer reference
- exact amount
- payment purpose
- receipt process

Do not rely on a forwarded bank account screenshot or informal WhatsApp instruction.

Official FaisalTown Group resources currently publish project payment methods and account information, so buyers should cross-check instructions against current developer documentation.

## Price comparisons

Online prices are useful for establishing a market range.

They should not be treated as official property valuations.

Asking prices can differ because of:

- exact block or sector
- plot size
- road width
- corner position
- possession
- development
- dues
- payment completion
- seller urgency
- house condition

Compare several like-for-like current properties.

## Development charges and premiums

Ask whether the quoted price includes:

- development charges
- possession charges
- transfer charges
- corner premium
- main-road premium
- park-facing premium
- other location charges

A low headline figure may not equal the final payable cost.

## Plot vs house

A plot may suit someone who wants:

- land ownership
- custom construction
- flexibility
- staged building

A house may suit someone who wants:

- faster occupancy
- existing utilities
- known surroundings
- less construction management

Compare land value and construction value separately.

## Plot vs high-rise unit

FaisalTown Group also develops high-rise projects such as Faisal Heights and Faisal Jewel.

These are not directly comparable to a residential plot.

A high-rise buyer should consider:

- apartment size
- floor
- building completion
- parking
- service charges
- common facilities
- handover
- rental potential

A plot buyer focuses more on land, road position, development and future construction.

## What buyers should verify before paying

Before paying a token, booking amount or major installment:

1. Confirm the exact project.
2. Confirm the phase.
3. Confirm the block, sector or enclave.
4. Confirm the exact plot, house or unit.
5. Match it to the correct map.
6. Verify seller or developer documentation.
7. Confirm payment status.
8. Check outstanding dues.
9. Confirm transfer eligibility.
10. Verify the current payment recipient.
11. Inspect the site.
12. Obtain a written receipt.

Do not proceed if the property description and documents do not match.

## Regulatory and approval checks

Do not treat a marketing brochure, map or portal listing as proof of regulatory approval.

For any property purchase, verify the current regulatory position with the relevant authority and current project documentation.

The correct question is not simply “is Faisal Town approved?”

It is:

- which project?
- which phase?
- which extension?
- which sector?
- which exact property?

Regulatory checks should be property-specific.

## Site visit checklist

During a site visit, check:

- access route
- exact location
- road width
- plot or house identity
- drainage
- plot level
- surrounding development
- nearby commercial areas
- occupancy
- utilities
- construction progress

For remote buyers, request a current live video and map pin.

## How to shortlist property

A useful shortlist should include only comparable options.

For each property record:

- phase
- block or sector
- size
- location
- asking price
- paid status
- outstanding balance
- possession
- development
- special-location premium
- total payable amount

This makes it much easier to compare genuine value.

## Common buyer mistakes

Avoid:

- mixing Phase 1 blocks with Phase 2 sectors
- using an old price sheet
- comparing booking price with fully paid resale price
- ignoring outstanding installments
- assuming a corner premium is included
- relying only on portal photos
- paying before document verification
- using a cropped map without the full context

Most costly property mistakes happen because important differences were ignored at the beginning.

## How to use this website

Start with the project that matches your goal.

For established Phase 1 property, use the Faisal Town Phase 1 hub and Block A, B or C guides.

For Phase 2, use the Faisal Town Phase 2 hub and the relevant Sector O, P, R, S, T or Overseas Enclave guide.

For broader searches, use:

- plots for sale
- houses for sale
- houses for rent
- map and location
- project comparisons

This structure keeps the property decision specific instead of relying on one generic Faisal Town page.

## Final buyer guidance

Faisal Town can offer very different property choices depending on which project and property type you mean.

An established Phase 1 plot, an under-development Phase 2 booking, a completed house and a high-rise apartment should not be compared using the same criteria.

First identify the exact project.

Then compare the property, documentation, development, payment position and total cost.

That approach is more useful than trying to decide whether “Faisal Town” as a whole is good or bad.

Is Faisal Town Phase 1 the same as Faisal Town Phase 2? | No. Faisal Town-I and Faisal Town-II are separate projects with different maps, development stages and property structures.

Is Faisal Town Phase 1 established? | FaisalTown Group currently describes significant possession, house construction and residential occupancy in Phase 1, although the exact property should still be checked before purchase.

Is Faisal Town Phase 2 developed? | FaisalTown Group currently describes Faisal Town-II as under development. Development can differ by sector, so verify the exact location on site.

Which blocks are in Faisal Town Phase 1? | The Phase 1 structure includes Block A, Block B, Block B-1 and Block C. This website has detailed guides for the main established A, B and C areas.

Which sectors are covered in Faisal Town Phase 2? | This website currently covers Sector O, Sector P, Sector R, Sector S, Sector T and Overseas Enclave.

Can I buy a plot in Faisal Town on installments? | Some Phase 2 inventory may have installment structures, while Phase 1 is mainly an established resale market. Always check the exact current property terms.

Should I trust online Faisal Town prices? | Use online asking prices for comparison only. Verify current availability, outstanding payments and the final payable amount before making a payment.

Should I use Google Maps or the project map? | Use both. Google Maps is useful for routes, while the project map is needed for block, sector and plot context.

What should I verify before paying a token? | Confirm the exact project, property, documents, payment status, dues, transfer procedure, payment recipient and receipt process before making a material payment.
